annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulation amends the lists of mandatorily reportable occurrences under Regulation 376/2014, so reporting duties fall on those who report occurrences in civil aviation (operators of manned aircraft and UAS, air navigation services, aerodromes, ground handling, maintenance and design/manufacturing organisations); it is binding in all Member States.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
annotation.dates_quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/1018 laying down a list classifying occurrences in civil aviation to be mandatorily reported, as regards Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS), U-space occurrences
